one_line: End on the finished piece turned on a stand from every side, after an honest first-try opener.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 hands hold the yellow kit box, tilted to the lens, on a lawn in low sun; flipped to its back at 0:02. Voice (transcript): "בואו איתי לנסות בפעם הראשונה את ערכת הפורפז מבית פלפוט". No text, no face.
q1_hook.why: A voice and the product in hand from 0:00, with no greeting first (H1, S1), and the box art shows the finished result (H2). But the hook is only said, not written, and there is no face (H6, H4). "First time" promises discovery, not a benefit or a question (H5).

beats.what: Hands hold the kit box on a lawn, front then back; "תישארו איתי"
beats.why: An honest first try, with the result on the box

beats.what: A blank white bear, then the contents one by one on a white table
beats.why: Shows what is in the box before any pouring

beats.what: A gloved hand layers three paints in a paper cup
beats.why: The first real step, close and colourful

beats.what: "רגע האמת": the first pour over the head, a near-drop, "זה מושלם"
beats.why: The promised moment, with a live reaction

beats.what: More pours down the body; drips and puddles grow on the mat
A small note: she stayed silent while working, the footage runs at X6
She refills the cup, pours and splashes, turns the bear; a split-colour box behind
beats.why: Long and similar to the earlier pours

beats.what: The finished bear on a white stand on a shelf, turned from every side
beats.why: The result, held back to the very end

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, save, share or comment ask in the video or the caption. "בואו נלמד את זה ביחד" (0:57, transcript) invites company, not a reply.
q2_flow.why: "Stay with me" and "רגע האמת" open and close a small first-try arc (H5, K2), and the finished bear lands at the end (R4). But 1:30 to 2:45 repeats one action with little new (R3, R1), and at 179 s the Reel runs close to the 3 minute ceiling (R2, E8).

q3_cta.what: None in the video (no ask in the transcript to 1:30; the rest is not covered) and none in the caption. Nearest lines: "תישארו איתי" (0:09), "בואו נלמד את זה ביחד" (0:57). No link, price or where to buy.
q3_cta.why: A viewer who stays three minutes gets no next step, not even where to buy (C6). There is no bait (C1, C2), but a reason to send it, such as a craft idea for a friend, is also missing (C4).

q4_shown.what: The box on a lawn at 0:00; a blank bear at 0:11; the contents one by one to 0:36; cup layering; pours over the bear 1:00 to 2:45; the finished bear on a shelf stand 2:47 to 2:59. Gloved hands only. No price, no child.
q4_shown.why: The box is handled at 0:00 and the whole process is shown in use, mess and a near-drop included, which reads honest (S1, S6). Hands only and no child suit a solo shoot (S4, S5). The finished result waits until 2:47 (R4).

q5_edit.what: About 14 shots in 179 s (first pass), about 12.8 s each, mostly long handheld takes with few cuts. A note at 1:58 says the footage runs at X6. Voice through 1:30 (transcript). One small text note. Ends on a shelf shot, no end card.
q5_edit.why: Long takes show each step, but with so few cuts the 1:30 to 2:45 stretch has little new (E2, R3). Speeding up an object's motion fits E3. No subtitles in 3 minutes of speech fail muted viewers (E4, T1). It ends cleanly on the result (E8).

q6_topic.what: A first try of a paint-pour kit, honest and in real time, for adults and parents who want a craft idea.
q6_topic.why: "My first time, let's learn together" is an honest, relatable stance (K6), with steps told inside a personal try (K4, K2). The reactions ("וואו איזה מגניב") give a small positive peak (K1). The caption says kids too, but no child appears and no occasion is named (K7).

q7_filmed.what: Handheld phone in low sun on a lawn: medium shots of the box and bear, close-ups of the gloved hand and cup, often near the pour. Last shots indoors on a shelf with game boxes behind.
q7_filmed.why: Close, handheld, hands-only shots show the pour from the maker's side (F5, F4) in a real backyard (H8, F7).

q8_text.on_screen: No headline and no subtitles. One small note at about 1:58 to 2:01, white bold, four lines, centred about 70% down: "שתדעו, שזה שאני שותקת תוך כדי עבודה זה שיא גינס! וזה רק בגלל שלא רציתי שתשמעו אותי מצייצת כשזה רץ על X6". Printed box text only otherwise.
q8_text.caption: "פינת היצירה של נופי!". About 49 words: series name, product and brand tag, a praise line, then "*תוכן בשיתוף פעולה" near the end, 5 hashtags (one repeated).
q8_text.why: With no subtitles, a muted viewer gets nothing from 3 minutes of speech (T1, H6), and the one note sits low in the frame (T4). The caption's first line is the series name, not a hook or a search word (T7). The partnership is named in words but near the end (T8, S7).

weak_points: 179 s for one kit; about 75 s of similar pours; no subtitles or headline; no price, where to buy or ask; the collaboration named only near the end of the caption.
lumebook_takeaway: Open with "first time, come with me", show the book and its contents on a table, and end on a turn-around shot of the finished book, hands only.
not_verified: Speech after 1:30 (the transcript covers 90 s; her 1:58 note says she was silent while working); music; whether the footage was actually sped up (read only from her note); the exact cut count. Corrections to src/coded: the Reel has one text note (about 1:58 to 2:01), not none; the last shots are on an indoor shelf, filmed apart from the lawn.
